title: Nominee Check
summary: Checks a bank, locker or demat nomination against India's 2025 bank rules and SEBI's 2026 limits, and reads back who gets what.
description: Nomination form check for bank deposits, lockers and demat/MF holdings: shares not adding to 100%, nominees past the limit (4 bank, 3 demat), splits on a locker, missing relationship or minor's date of birth, minors with no adult, duplicates and no nominee, with a plain readback.
catches: Simultaneous shares that don't add to 100%
Nominees beyond the limit: 4 for bank deposits and lockers, 3 for demat and MF from 1 Sep 2026
Percentage split on a locker, which allows successive nomination only
Demat nominee without a relationship, or a minor without a date of birth
Minor nominee with no adult to receive, the same person twice, and no nominee
limits: Indian rules only, baked in as of the sources below; they can change
Doesn't submit or verify the nomination with your bank or depository
a11y: The nominee list is a labelled group described by the issues list
Focus moves to the relevant row or fix after a change

sources.label: SEBI circular SEBI/HO/OIAE/OIAE_IAD-3/P/CIR/2026/12676 (29 May 2026, effective 1 Sep 2026)

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Confirmed: deposits up to four nominees successive or simultaneous, lockers up to four successively, from 1 Nov 2025; demat/MF up to 3 nominees from 1 Sep 2026. Minor-nominee and odd-lot details were not re-checked line by line.

stops: Helps catch nominee shares that don't add to 100%
